program_name: Bachelor of Science in Halal Management

fees.notes: Official UIS international fee for Ijazah Sarjana Muda Pengurusan (Industri Halal) (Bachelor in Management (Halal Industry) (Hons)) (programme code bb08), last published on study.uis.edu.my (capture 20240722212546): RM50,884 total, an all-inclusive package covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D, full-time only) and graduation. UIS's current programme page (https://study.uis.edu.my/bb08, accessed 2026-09-18) says tuition fee information will be updated soon, so this is the latest officially published international figure. fees.per_year = total / official duration.
